Exit 20 is strictly narrower than the old exit 2 behavior — it fires only for a completed zero-match search with a parseable, non-future marker below the floor; poll exhaustion, search failure, unmeasurable age, and submit's retry-verification wait all remain exit 2, and each of those branches has an explicit test.
